items.title: Mike Evans: Could be back at practice Thursday
items.text:
San Francisco general manager John Lynch said that "there's a chance" Evans (Achilles) will take part in a padded practice Thursday, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Geno Smith: Limited, but plans to play Sunday
items.text:
Smith (ankle), who was a limited participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice, said afterward that he intends to play in Sunday's game against the Chargers, Rich Cimini of ESPN.com reports.
